title: CompanySearchResponse
description: A list of companies that match the criteria specified in the request

data.description: The primary data of the document

meta.description: Non-standard meta information about the document

links.description: Links related to the primary data

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource

city.description: City of the company's primary address.

state.description: State or province of the company's primary address.

country.description: Country of the company's primary address.

revenue.description: Approximate yearly revenue for the company in 1000's. For example, a 100M company is expressed as 100000.

employeeCount.description: Approximate number of people employed by the company.

logo.description: The URL which can be used to retrieve the logo for the company.

first.description: A link to the first page of data

last.description: A link to the last page of data

prev.description: A link to the previous page of data

next.description: A link to the next page of data

Links.description: Helpful links for fetching different pages of data from the current result set. When using these links, please provide the exact same request body between requests

underManagement.description: Indicates whether record is under management within the contract period.

purchaseDate.description: Indicates when record was purchased if it is under management.

total.description: The total number of pages within the current result set

number.description: The current page number of the results

Page.description: Meta information related to the current page and total number of pages

totalResults.description: The total number of results based on the specified filters

page.description: Paging information for the current result set

ResultMeta.description: Metadata including paging information and the total number of records in the result set
